Example Trust Merit Scholarship

The Example Trust invites applications for its merit scholarship.

Eligibility

Students who have secured at least 75% marks in the previous examination and are enrolled in an undergraduate course in a recognised institution in India are eligible to apply. The annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3,50,000 per annum.

Scholarship Amount

The scholarship amount is Rs. 25,000 per annum towards tuition fees.

Important Dates

Applications open from 01 August 2026.

Last date to apply: 30 September 2026

Documents Required

  • Marksheet of previous examination
  • Income certificate
  • Aadhaar card

Selection Process

Selection is based on merit and an interview of shortlisted candidates.

The scholarship is renewable for the next academic year subject to satisfactory academic performance.
